text.p: Adeza Biomedical Corp said Monday it sued its marketing partner, Matria Healthcare Inc, alleging that Matria breached an exclusive marketing agreement and engaged in unfair competition.
Adeza alleges Matria failed to use its best efforts to promote and market Adeza's test for predicting premature birth. Adeza seeks to end its agreement with Matria.

Adeza developed and manufactures a proprietary enzyme- linked immunosorbent assay (ELISA) diagnostic known as the fFN ELISA Test. The test detects the presence of the protein fetal fibronectin (fFN), which has been demonstrated to predict preterm delivery when found in the cervicovaginal secretions of women with between 24 and 34 completed weeks of pregnancy, Adeza said.
Matria did not return calls seeking comment. Matria lost one to 4-1/2.
